name: Jose Enrique Aguilar
description: Full Stack developer. I have experience in React, Next.js, Vue, FastAPI, Django and Laravel. I'm interested in architecture and design patterns to organize the code so that the product can evolve.
aboutmeDescription:
After years training in healthcare —what I thought was my dream— I decided to make the switch to tech. From the moment I started writing my first lines of code, I knew my real passion was development.

In my day-to-day building web applications, I pay special attention to software architecture, design patterns, and best practices. I'm passionate about learning new things that help me keep improving, so I can structure higher-quality, more maintainable code.

Away from the keyboard, you'll find me enjoying a good coffee, whether I'm walking around the city with music on or gaming.
